en.title: Attended {{DevFest 2023 - GDG Live Pakistan}}
en.text: I recently attended a well-organized tech event that provided valuable knowledge and networking opportunities. The sessions were interactive and covered a variety of topics led by experienced speakers. It was a great platform to connect with like-minded professionals and enhance my understanding of current technological trends.
list: Engaged with [[Eric Bhatti]], [[Arsalan Khattak]], and [[Hufsa Munawar]] through interactive sessions⚡
Learned about improving user experience from expert [[Talal Athar]]

Benefited from panel discussions featuring [[Hassaan Yousafzai]], [[Asharib Ahmed]], and [[Sarwat Rizvi]]

en.title: Attended {{DevFest 2023 – GDG Islamabad}}
en.text: I attended [[DevFest'23]], hosted by Google Developer Groups Islamabad. The event provided valuable networking opportunities and featured impressive AI insights presented by Arslan Javed from Musavir.AI. Muhammad Umar Nazir led an engaging networking session, creating a welcoming environment. Thanks to all speakers for their valuable contributions. The event concluded with giveaways and a memorable closing ✨
list: Explored cutting-edge AI imagery and technology innovations
Participated in a lively and memorable networking session
Connected with industry experts and passionate developers
Enjoyed a warm community atmosphere and great event organization

en.title: Attended {{Hacktoberfest 2023}}
en.institution: Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors UET Taxila & Artificial Intelligence Research and Development Society - UET Taxila
en.text: I had the privilege to host and participate in [[Hacktoberfest 2023]], an inspiring event that brought together developers and tech enthusiasts to collaborate and innovate. The sessions featured insightful talks by our distinguished guest speakers, Arsalan Khattak, who shared valuable knowledge and expertise. The event was a tremendous success thanks to the efforts of the organizers and collaborators, including Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors UET Taxila and the Artificial Intelligence Research and Development Society at UET Taxila 💻
list: Hosted the event and facilitated smooth execution of sessions
Gained practical insights from expert speakers on open source contributions
Engaged with a vibrant community of developers and learners
Appreciated the collaborative spirit and organization behind the event
Enhanced my understanding of community-driven development and networking

en.title: Attended {{DevFest 2024 – GDG Islamabad}}
en.text: I had the incredible opportunity to attend [[DevFest 2024]], hosted by Google Developer Groups Islamabad at Pearl Continental Hotel Rawalpindi. The event was a powerful blend of inspiring talks, hands-on learning, and meaningful networking. It was truly energizing to connect with like-minded professionals and gain valuable insights from industry leaders💫
list: Inspiring sessions delivered by speakers including Muhammad Umar Nazir, Mohammad Ali Ibrahim, Yasir Pirkani, Emad Ehsan, Mashhood Rastgar, Andleeb Aslam, Mehwish Tariq, and Wajahat Karim
Engaged in discussions on AI, innovation, and software development best practices
Networked with developers, tech leaders, and community builders from across Pakistan
Appreciation to GDG Islamabad for organizing such a well-executed and impactful event

en.title: Attended {{AI Session at Microsoft Qatar}}
en.text: I recently attended an insightful session titled [["Making Language Models More Reliable: How To Detect & Reduce Hallucinations"]], hosted at Microsoft Office Qatar 🇶🇦. The session was led by Samir Abdaljalil, a PhD researcher from Texas A&M University, who shared advanced techniques in improving AI reliability — including sparse autoencoders and methods to detect hallucinations in LLMs. 💡
list: Explored key challenges in LLM reliability and real-world risks of hallucinations
Learned about sparse autoencoders and error reduction strategies in NLP
Connected with Fatima Tayeb, Cloud Solution Architect at Microsoft — a truly inspiring leader
Engaged in meaningful tech conversations and networking with peers including Fereshta Rahmani
